title: Add catalog statistics endpoint
body:
## Summary
- Adds `GET /api/catalog/statistics` to Catalog.API returning aggregate metrics: total items, brands, types, items out of stock, items on reorder, total available stock, and average/min/max price.
- Introduces `CatalogStatistics` model and registers the endpoint under both API versions (v1 + v2) with a new `Statistics` tag.
- Regenerates `Catalog.API.json` / `Catalog.API_v2.json` to include the new operation and schema.

## Test plan
- [ ] `dotnet build src/Catalog.API/Catalog.API.csproj` (passes locally)
- [ ] Run Catalog.API and `GET /api/catalog/statistics?api-version=1.0` returns expected counts/prices against seed data
- [ ] Verify response on an empty catalog returns zeroed prices without error
- [ ] Confirm OpenAPI documents render the new endpoint in Swagger UI
